digest.component_or_area: test infrastructure — CI workflow parity collection
propositions: _collect_node_ids launches nested pytest collection without --basetemp, causing cleanup to operate on shared numbered temp root and potentially delete or traverse unrelated temp trees from concurrent runs
pytest session shutdown via cleanup_numbered_dir/rmtree can collide with other run temp directories when subprocess temp state is not isolated

nested collection subprocess must receive caller-owned private --basetemp directory to prevent sibling temp root interference while preserving collection selection, stdout parsing, return-code contract, and timeout semantics
the _store_isolation helper pattern for temp isolation does not cover independent callers like _collect_node_ids
